n1.speaker: player
n1.text: (A floorboard complains at four in the morning. You follow the sound into the hall.)

n2.speaker: player
n2.text: (Faelen is kneeling outside Momo's door with a cup of bitter tea. Beside it: the little lamp Momo said she could not afford.)

n3.speaker: faelen
n3.text: You're loud when you think you're being quiet.

n4.speaker: player
n4.text: "And you're generous when you think nobody's awake."

n5.speaker: faelen
n5.text: She has not slept in two nights. Exhausted mages miscast. This is maintenance.

n6.speaker: player
n6.text: (The door opens a finger's width. Momo takes the cup. Her whisper barely reaches the hall.)

n8.speaker: player
n8.text: (Faelen waits until the lock clicks again before she rises.)

n9.speaker: faelen
n9.text: Do not mistake usefulness for kindness.

choices.text: "You don't have to hide that you care."
(Let the excuse stand. Help her gather the empty cups.)

press3.speaker: faelen
press3.text: Everything is armor, if you intend to survive it.

patience1.speaker: player
patience1.text: (You stack the cups. She watches you leave her lie untouched.)

patience2.speaker: faelen
patience2.text: You are not going to ask why I was awake.

patience3.speaker: player
patience3.text: "You know where to find me when you want to answer."

patience4.speaker: faelen
patience4.text: That is a dangerous amount of patience.

converge.speaker: player
converge.text: (At breakfast, Momo's new lamp is on. Faelen sharpens her spear with her back to everyone.)

n10.speaker: faelen
n10.text: The stair rail is loose. I'll repair it after patrol.
